svg.title: Notifications about new documents
svg.desc: Every five minutes, a background job asks Paperless-ngx once for the documents that it added since the last run, and they wait for their files. While no file has arrived, Paperless gets no further request. Once a file is in the archive account, the job asks Paperless once per distinct saved search which of those documents it finds. Each user who asked for a document and can open its file gets one notification, with a link to each file that it names.
